material.title: Withings launches a new eight-electrode body composition scale
material.bodyOriginal: Withings today announced its new eight-electrode body composition scale, priced at $199.99 in the US and available from October. The scale adds segmental measurement and a 0.05 kg resolution.

material.title: 10 ways a smart scale will change your morning routine
material.bodyOriginal: A smart scale is everywhere. Here are ten ways it might change how you start your day, from weight trends to habit reminders. Sign up for our course to learn more.
